A reprogrammed [[B1-series battle droid]] worked as a '''foreman''' on [[Plazir-15]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. The [[droid]] oversaw a number of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s that had been reprogrammed for load lifting. Upon seeing reports that droids had been malfunctioning on Plazir-15, the foreman had the B2 loaders undergo maintenance, which was certified. After he did so, he was questioned by [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] as [[Din Djarin]] interfered with some of the B2 battle droids. After answering some of Kryze's questions, the droid warned Djarin against interfering with the droids as, although they had been re-certified, they still had been originally designed for warfare and could be dangerous. Djarin then pushed [[Unidentified rogue B2-series battle droid|a B2 droid]] down, who then fled and was attacked by Kryze and Djarin, the latter of whom immediately chased after the B2. Kryze mocked the foreman's claims that the loaders had been re-certified, and the droid again repeated that Djarin should not have interfered with the loader as Kryze joined Djarin's pursuit.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
